dropHint: Drop a GLB here or click to open
sharpEdgeHint: Dihedral angle threshold (degrees). Edges sharper than this are preserved as feature edges.
smoothNormalHint: Smooth normal angle threshold (degrees). 0 = faceted; larger values remesh smoother.
adaptivityHint: Curvature-adaptive quad density. 0 = uniform, 1 = full adaptivity.
anisotropyHint: Curvature-adaptive elongation. 0 = square quads, 1 = stretched along flatter directions.
remeshCollapsedQuad: Quad remesh collapsed the mesh — try isotropic mode or a different model
remeshCollapsed: Remesh collapsed the mesh — try a different target or model
remeshEmpty: Remesher produced an empty mesh — try a denser input or different target
